rationale: The plan matches the reference exactly: a single DESeq2 fit with subject as the blocking term, an LRT of ~ subject + condition against ~ subject for any condition effect, then three named pairwise contrasts including the two-coefficient A vs B contrast shrunk with ashr (correctly noting apeglm cannot take it), BH at 0.05 within contrast, and no post hoc fold-change cutoff. The low count filter (10 counts in at least 4 samples, the smallest group) is minimal and justified, and median-of-ratios normalization is explicitly inside the model with no pre-normalization. QC is complete (blind VST PCA, distance heatmap, library sizes, colored by subject and condition) though the outlier policy is only to flag rather than a stated decision rule. Enrichment is correctly omitted, and the report specifies method, versions, design, thresholds, tested and DE counts, sessionInfo, per-contrast FDR caveats, the small-n caveat, and an edgeR QL robustness check.
